camera_registration.previous: prev_setupcam/: the earlier Stage 2 used the setup's ego camera as it is (source='setup'); its projected cloth sits ~30 px below the cloth edges of this video (another camera mounting: 8 cm further back, 2 deg more pitch), which put the box 11 cm too far from the robot
camera_registration.fovy_note: the cloth fixes the pose for any lens but not the lens itself; GeoCalib (estimate_gravity, run in the sam3d-objects env where geocalib is installed) gives vfov 47 / pitch 42 here, but on the setup-camera clip open_the_bottle it reads vfov 40 / pitch 37 for the calibrated 38 / 34, and its vfov varies 40-45 between clips of one mounting, so it cannot overrule the calibrated lens; with fovy 44 the box would sit 7 cm farther (y 0.447), same width
